description: Create a centralized state management system for the lexical editor toolbar to dramatically reduce main thread blocking during user interactions. Replace the current per-component update listener subscriptions with a single hook that computes all toolbar states in one pass, then convert toolbar components to stateless presentational components that receive their state as props.
functional_requirements: Implement a centralized `useToolbarStates` hook that computes all active/enabled states for toolbar items in a single pass when the editor updates
Refactor `ToolbarButton` and `ToolbarDropdown` components to be stateless and receive their active/enabled states as props from the centralized hook
Replace the dropdown icon/label derivation logic that currently uses useState/useEffect with a direct useMemo calculation from the centralized group state
Add a dedicated benchmark suite with CPU-throttled typing tests to measure and track performance improvements
